name: creative-clippath
title: Creative Squiggle Clip Path
blurb: Image/video grid with organic squiggly clip path shapes.
description: Renders a 3-column grid of images/videos clipped to creative organic shapes via SVG clip paths. Includes hover scale animation.
use_when: Artistic galleries, creative portfolios, or non-corporate image layouts.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical edges (clipping hides content); low-end devices (clip-path cost).
a11y: Static grid with alt text and video controls. Clip paths are decorative.
